sloka: अनपत्येन च स्नेहादङ्कमारोप्य च स्वयम् ।ममेयं तनयेत्युक्त्वा स्नेहो मयि निपातित: ॥ २.११८.३०॥
transliteration: anapatyena ca snehādaṅkamāropya ca svayam ।mameyaṁ tanayetyuktvā sneho mayi nipātita: ॥ 2.118.30॥

translations.english: As he had no children, he, on his own accord, lifted me up and placing me on his lap, saying, This is my daughter, he began showering (lots of) love on me.
